name: 07981 · Whippany, NJ
findings: ZIP 07981 (Whippany) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07981 (Whippany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07981 (Whippany) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).
